rules.name: TD3 MRZ Structural Integrity
rules.description: Passport must possess 2 lines of 44 alphanumeric characters conforming to OCR-B TD3 standard.

rules.name: MRZ Mathematical Check Digits
rules.description: Document number, Date of Birth, Expiry date, and Composite check digits must evaluate correctly modulo 10.

rules.name: Visual vs MRZ Date of Birth Consistency
rules.description: Date of Birth extracted from Visual Inspection Zone (VIZ) must match decoded MRZ Date of Birth.

rules.name: Visual vs MRZ Document Number Consistency
rules.description: Document number extracted from Visual Inspection Zone must match decoded MRZ Document Number.

rules.name: Document Expiry Validation
rules.description: Passport date of expiry must be strictly after current screening date.

rules.name: Date of Birth Plausibility
rules.description: Holder must be between 0 and 110 years of age at time of screening.

rules.name: Issue vs Expiry Duration Plausibility
rules.description: Validity period should typically not exceed 10.5 years from issuance date.

rules.name: Border Reference Watchlist Check
rules.description: Document number must not match any flagged or suspended record in the reference watchlist.
